scope: Independent source review of seven frozen managed-assistant files; no provider, account, native service or package action.
verdict: Blocked by Stop-versus-running-quota interleaving before source acceptance/build.

finding.location: voice/maslow_voice/assistant_runtime.py AssistantClient.status and voice/maslow_voice/tasks.py TaskManager._run quota exception transition
finding.problem: The new running-status cooldown detection can raise from an in-flight status response after a concurrent user Stop has already persisted stopping. The outer quota exception handler unconditionally writes waiting_input, undoing the Stop state and exposing Continue semantics after cancellation. Excluding upstream status=stopping is insufficient because the returned status can be stale running.
finding.fixtureScope: Actual TaskManager, AssistantClient and temporary SQLite task store. Held in-memory request response, mocked stop/process termination/router release; no socket, provider, account or service call. One CPU/nice10.
finding.minimumFix: At the quota exception transition, freshly inspect the task state and preserve current stopping/terminal precedence without an intervening await. Ensure owned process release and account cleanup still occur, without automatic resubmit or conversion back to waiting_input. Add deterministic Stop-during-status coverage and terminal-state protection; retain the normal running-to-waiting quota case.

verifiedReviewPoints: All seven frozen source SHA values and three recorded installed SDK static SHA values matched.

Installed Hermes agent_init explicitly interprets api_max_retries=1 as a single app-level attempt and auto_recovery_cycles=0 as disabling recovery. conversation_loop uses retry_count < max_retries; primary OpenAI construction in agent_runtime_helpers defaults max_retries to zero, avoiding an extra transport retry layer on the reviewed path.

Managed worker rejects missing or differing retry attributes after construction and retains the exact managed-tool allowlist. This is compatibility checking, not a guarantee for arbitrary future SDK versions.

Actual Hermes Runs emits event/tool with tool.started/tool.completed. Normalization retains only string type/tool_name/status fields; arguments, previews, results and reasoning fields are omitted. Legacy event shape remains supported.
Workspace-relative instructions clarify granted paths without modifying tool authorization, file validation or checked-note receipts.

Normal quota pause retains task capabilities and attempt/idempotency identity and releases the owned process/router reservation; it does not automatically resubmit. Completed/cancelled/stopping upstream statuses are exempt, but the separate local Stop race above remains.

testsAndLimits.authorEvidence: 60 focused tests and network-isolated actual SDK profile probe reported in exact frozen checkpoint; not duplicated by reviewer.
testsAndLimits.independentExecution: One deterministic adversarial interleaving, reproduced against actual source. No full suite or live provider call.
testsAndLimits.notAccepted: Installed fix, Voice42 artifact, live document/note completion, live account cleanup, audio/hardware and quota-recovery behavior remain unaccepted. Long AF_UNIX heartbeat-path limitation remains separate and noncausal for this source finding.
